CustomField.description: Field defaults to Parent/Standalone Account unless changed by requestor or BOA. This field identifies whether the account is a true account, or the type of child account if it isn’t a true account.
CustomField.inlineHelpText:
Parent/Standalone: Controls or owns other accounts, or an account that exists independently w/o subsidiaries
Subsidiary: Owned or controlled by a parent company.
Independent Subsidiary: A subsidiary that operates independently from its parent company.
Holding Company/Investment Firm: An account that holds investments or controls other businesses.
Non-Account Record: Vendors, Resellers that are not considered a customer or prospect, etc
CustomField.label: ETM Category
